Imran Khan's sons warn of health crisis, claim torture in prison

Sons of former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan have warned of a fatal health crisis for their father, alleging he is subjected to physical and mental torture in prison. Khan himself has written to Pakistan's top judges, including the Chief Justices of the Supreme Court and Islamabad High Court, stating his health is failing in solitary confinement. He claims 85% vision loss and warns of a brain hemorrhage, expressing fear he may not return alive from Adiala jail and seeking hospital care for himself and Bushra Bibi. Reports also mention a cardiac warning and alarming medical claims from his cell.
